battle.name: 安軍攻佔東都之戰
battle.brief: 天寶十四年（755）七月，安祿山以奉密詔討楊國忠為名自范陽起兵，三鎮兵沿河北道南下，先後陷陳留、鄭州，十一月（公曆12月）攻入東都洛陽。守軍出洛水北迎戰即潰；安軍以配石砲壓制城頭毀壞樓堞，再以撞車雲梯攻門，遂入洛陽。安祿山即位，國號大燕。卡面為古羅馬投石機，與唐製配石砲同類。

kit.name: 投石機
kit.history: 把絞盤的勢能換成一塊石頭。攻城從此有了可以計算的破壞力。

countries: 交戰分兩方。安軍一方以安祿山為首，據范陽、平盧、河東三鎮節度使的兵權，骨幹是久鎮北方的蕃漢騎兵，並有契丹、奚族將士參戰；旗下有史思明、史思義等大將與高尚、嚴莊等謀士，起兵後自稱雄武皇帝，國號大燕，年號聖武，以洛陽為都。唐廷一方由玄宗李隆基與宰相楊國忠主持中樞，坐鎮長安的禁軍與京畿守軍、河南道各州兵屬其節制；守洛陽者為河南尹崔光遠與左武衛大將軍陳玄誼所領的留守部隊。與此同時，范陽、平盧、河東三鎮的唐代舊將多望風迎降，但河北道常山太守顏杲卿、平原太守顏真卿起兵拒叛，號召河北十七郡，形成安軍後方與唐軍共存的拉鋸局面。安軍在河北、河東、河南三道以據點分兵，唐廷則以長安、潼關、太原為軸心，雙方在黃河兩岸與洛水流域展開為期八年的拉鋸；叛軍佔領區與唐軍控制區大致以黃河及潼關至洛陽的通道為界線，糧秣、馬匹與兵源的爭奪尤為激烈。
countriesEn: The two sides in this conflict were the rebel army of An Lushan and the Tang court. An's host was built on the troops of the three frontier military districts of Fanyang, Pinglu and Hedong, which he held as military governor; its backbone was the mixed Chinese and foreign cavalry of the northern frontier, with Khitan and Xi soldiers in the ranks. Under him served great generals such as Shi Siming and Shi Siyi and advisers such as Gao Shang and Yan Zhuang, and once the revolt began he proclaimed himself emperor Wu of the Great Yan with the era name Shengwu, making Luoyang his capital. The Tang side was the central government of Emperor Xuanzong and Chancellor Yang Guozhong, with the capital guards of Chang'an, the garrison of the capital region and the troops of the prefectures of Henan's circuit under its orders; Luoyang itself was held by the Henan prefect Cui Guangyuan and the Left Imperial Guard commander Chen Xuanyi with the resident troops. At the same time many of the old Tang officers of the three districts threw down their banners as An advanced, but the prefect of Changshan, Yan Gaoqing, and the prefect of Pingyuan, Yan Zhenqing, rose against the rebels and called the seventeen prefectures of Hebei to arms, so that the rear of the rebel army was never secure. An's forces were posted in depots across Hebei, Hedong and Henan, while the Tang anchored themselves on Chang'an, Tong Pass and Taiyuan, and the two sides fought along the banks of the Yellow River and the valley of the Luo in a struggle that ran for eight years. The rebel-held and the Tang-held areas were divided roughly by the Yellow River and by the corridor from Tong Pass to Luoyang, and the struggle over grain, horses and recruits was especially fierce.
people: 安祿山是本役的關鍵人物。他出身營州雜胡，通曉六蕃語言，先平定奚、契丹，又兼領范陽、平盧、河東三鎮節度使，握北邊重兵，與宰相楊國忠互相猜忌。755年他打出奉密詔討楊國忠的旗號起兵，親率大軍南下，十一月入洛陽即皇帝位，國號大燕，年號聖武。史思明是安祿山的義子與左膀，河北方面的殘局多由他收拾；史思義、崔乾祐、安守忠等分將一軍，高尚、嚴莊則替安祿山籌劃方略與應對朝廷之策。唐廷方面，楊國忠是安祿山起兵的直接目標，玄宗李隆基在洛陽陷落後西幸成都，龍武大將軍陳玄禮在馬嵬驛迫殺楊貴妃；御史中丞郭子儀力主固守潼關、以逸待勞，安西都護李光弼亦被起用，河西節度使哥舒翰奉命守關。守城一方的河南尹崔光遠出洛水北迎戰而殉，左武衛大將軍陳玄誼與城共存亡。河北方面，常山太守顏杲卿起兵後被叛軍擒獲，父子相繼殉難；平原太守顏真卿則被推為河北義兵盟主，成為日後收復兩京的河北支柱。
peopleEn: An Lushan is the central figure of this campaign. A man of mixed tribal stock born at Yingzhou in Liaodong, he spoke the languages of the six foreign peoples, had pacified the Xi and the Khitan, and came to hold the military governorships of Fanyang, Pinglu and Hedong at once, with the heavy armies of the northern frontier in his hand, while Chancellor Yang Guozhong mistrusted him. In 755 he rose at Fanyang under the banner of a secret imperial edict against Yang Guozhong, led the main body south in person, entered Luoyang in the eleventh month, and there assumed the imperial title of Wu of the Great Yan with the era name Shengwu. Shi Siming, his adopted son and strongest lieutenant, took charge of mopping up in Hebei; Shi Siyi, Cui Qianyou and An Shouzhong commanded separate columns, while the strategists Gao Shang and Yan Zhuang worked out the plan of march and the handling of the court. On the Tang side Yang Guozhong was the declared target of the rising; after Luoyang fell Xuanzong fled west to Chengdu, and the Imperial Guard commander Chen Xili forced the death of Consort Yang at Mawei. The censor-in-chief Guo Ziyi urged the court to hold Tong Pass and let the invaders exhaust themselves, the Anxi protector Li Guangbi was brought back into service, and the Hexi governor Geshu Han was ordered to defend the pass. Cui Guangyuan, prefect of Henan, marched out north of the Luo River and was killed in the fighting; Chen Xuanyi of the Left Imperial Guard died with the city. In Hebei, the prefect of Changshan, Yan Gaoqing, was taken alive after his rising and was executed with his son, father and son perishing one after the other; the prefect of Pingyuan, Yan Zhenqing, was acclaimed leader of the Hebei volunteers and became the pillar of the Tang recovery of the two capitals.
kits: 卡面這件投石機是古羅馬的 onager：以木製機架、扭力弓臂與配重臂把人力轉化成石彈的動能，公元前三世紀已在歐洲的攻城戰中使用。本役現場並無羅馬人馬，唐軍與叛軍用的是同一技術譜系的拋石器，唐人稱配石砲、拋石機、砲車或投石機，多以木車承載，須眾人挽弓蓄力，待令齊發。其用途是以數十至數百斤的石塊打擊城頭女牆、城樓與城門，逼守軍不能立於城垛，同時打散城中街巷裡的集結隊形；安軍在陳留、鄭州、洛陽一線攻堅時，正是靠這類器械在遠處壓制城頭，再用騎兵與步卒貼城突門。與之配合的還有撞車、撞竿、雲梯、井車與雲車等攻城器械，以及火矢與長鉤，用以焚燒、掀翻敵方攻具。除攻城器外，雙方野戰仍以唐制橫刀、長槊、臂弩、床弩與障車為主；騎兵著明光鎧、馬鎧，安軍騎隊以契丹、奚族戰馬構成骨幹，糧秣則靠牛車、驢車沿驛道與運河轉運。
kitsEn: The card's weapon is the onager, a Roman stone-throwing engine: a wooden frame, torsion arms and a counterweighted throwing arm turn human muscle into the kinetic energy of a stone, and engines of this type were already in use in European sieges by the third century BC. No Roman soldiers were present in this campaign; the Tang and the rebels used throwing engines of the same technical family, called in Chinese the peishi pao, the pao-che or the tou-shi-ji, usually mounted on wooden carts, drawn back by many men and released together on command. Their purpose was to strike the parapets, towers and gates of a city with stones of dozens to hundreds of catties, so that the defenders could not stand on the ramparts and so that formations gathering in the streets inside were broken up. In the hard fighting along the line of Chenliu, Zhengzhou and Luoyang it was exactly such machines that suppressed the walls from a distance, after which cavalry and infantry closed against the gates. Beside them the besiegers used battering rams, ram-poles, scaling ladders, well-carts and observation towers, together with fire arrows and long hooks to burn and overturn the enemy's siege gear. Away from the walls both sides still fought with Tang-pattern sabres, long lances, hand crossbows, bed crossbows and spiked barricades; the cavalry wore bright armour for men and horses, and the mounted core of An's host rode the horses of the Khitan and the Xi. Supplies were moved by ox-carts and donkeys along the post roads and the canals.
tactics: 安軍的戰法是速決與壓迫並用。起兵之後，三鎮兵分道南下，主力沿河北道平原大道直趨陳留、洛陽，其餘各部以輕騎疾進、掠取沿途府庫、驅丁為兵，遇城多不攻城而過，只在陳留、鄭州、洛陽等要地集中攻堅。洛陽攻城時，安軍先以配石砲、拋石機在城外列陣，晝夜轟擊城樓女牆，再以步卒推撞車、扛雲梯逼近城牆，騎兵沿城垣巡馳，掩護攻具接近並封鎖各門；城破之後，分兵控制城門、劫取倉儲，驅使丁壯隨軍，轉眼把洛陽變成向外進攻的基地與糧秣來源。守方則以河南尹崔光遠率部出洛水北迎戰，兵敗殉城，餘部退保城內，以弩砲居高臨下反制，但城頭既已被砲火壓垮，難以持續支撐。洛陽陷落後，唐廷把防線收縮到潼關，以逸待勞一度爭得喘息，但同年六月哥舒翰違制出關迎戰，兵敗靈寶，長安隨即淪陷。安軍自七月起兵到十一月取洛陽只用約四個多月，靠的正是這種不戍一城、直搗中心的打法。
tacticsEn: An Lushan's method combined speed with pressure. Once the rising began, the troops of the three districts moved south by several routes, the main body racing along the great roads of the Hebei plain toward Chenliu and Luoyang, while the other columns rode ahead with light cavalry, stripping the treasuries of the towns they passed and pressing the men of the country into the ranks. Most cities were passed without a siege, and only at places like Chenliu, Zhengzhou and Luoyang did the army concentrate its strength for a real assault. At Luoyang the rebels first deployed their peishi pao and pao-che outside the walls and pounded the towers and parapets day and night, then brought up battering rams and scaling ladders under cover, while cavalry patrolled along the curtain wall, screened the approach of the siege gear and sealed the gates. After the city fell they detached troops to hold the gates, plundered the granaries, drove the men of the city into the army, and turned Luoyang in a single night into a base for further advance and a source of grain. The defence tried the opposite: Henan prefect Cui Guangyuan marched out with his troops north of the Luo River and was killed, and the survivors fell back inside the walls to shoot from the towers, but with the parapets already smashed by the stone-throwers the defence could not be sustained. After Luoyang fell the court pulled its line back to Tong Pass, and the policy of waiting at leisure in a fortified position bought a measure of breathing space, but in the sixth month of the same year Geshu Han left the pass against orders to give battle, was beaten at Lingbao, and Chang'an was lost. That An reached Luoyang in some four or five months was the fruit of this refusal to garrison city after city and to strike straight at the centre.
data: 可據的數字有幾組。時間上，天寶十四年（755）七月安祿山自范陽出師，十一月陷東都洛陽（公曆755年12月），前後約四個多月。兵力上，《資治通鑑》記安祿山起兵時奏集蕃漢三鎮兵十五萬，其後又續募逃戶與罪人從軍，總數當以此為上限，各家記載略有出入。地理上，自范陽至洛陽道路約一千四百餘里；自洛陽東出至潼關約七百餘里；自洛陽至長安約七百餘里；玄宗自長安西幸成都，全程約三千餘里，翌年正月始抵蜀中。城池上，唐東都洛陽內城（皇城）周長約五里有餘，外郭城周長約六十餘里，跨洛水有天津橋相連，兵家謂洛陽八關環繞，北有黃河與邙山之險，南接汝、洛水系，南北向的進攻與退路都要仰賴橋梁與城門。物資上，洛陽是北方漕運的總匯與大倉所在，叛軍取洛陽即取得兵源、馬匹與糧秣。至於城破時雙方死傷的確數，舊籍多不載，記錄者各執一說，此處不強作推算。
dataEn: Several groups of figures can be relied on. In time, An Lushan marched out of Fanyang in the seventh month of the fourteenth year of Tianbao (755) and took the eastern capital Luoyang in the eleventh month, that is December 755, a matter of some four months. In strength, the Zizhi Tongjian records that at the rising An reported gathering a hundred and fifty thousand men of Chinese and foreign stock from the three districts, and that he afterwards continued to enlist runaways and convicts; the total should be taken as no more than that, and the sources differ somewhat. In geography, the road from Fanyang to Luoyang runs about one thousand four hundred li; from Luoyang east to Tong Pass about seven hundred li; from Luoyang to Chang'an about seven hundred li; and the emperor's flight west from Chang'an to Chengdu covers some three thousand li, the court reaching Shu only in the first month of the following year. For the city, the inner enceinte of the Tang eastern capital, the imperial city, measured a little over five li round, while the outer wall ran a little over sixty li, with the Tianjin bridge crossing the Luo River; military writers called Luoyang ringed by the eight passes, with the Yellow River and Mount Mang to the north and the Ru and Luo waters to the south, so that every movement of an army north or south had to use the bridges and the gates. In supply, Luoyang was the hinge of the northern grain transport and the site of the great granaries, so that by taking it the rebels gained recruits, horses and grain at once. As for exact casualty figures on both sides when the city fell, the old histories do not record them, the witnesses disagree, and no estimate is offered here.
cause: 安史之亂的起因，是開元以來邊鎮體制與宰相權力互相羈絆，到天寶末年收束成一場叛亂。安祿山一身兼任范陽、平盧、河東三鎮節度使，據《資治通鑑》記其擁兵二十萬，卻得不到朝廷充分信任；宰相楊國忠與他互相猜忌，屢次主張討伐，河北道的契丹、奚族叛掠又迫得邊軍把大量精銳用於戍防。三鎮節度使的兵權本已是節度使的私人部曲，朝廷無法調度，成為叛軍起家的本錢。天寶十四年（755），玄宗下詔分割安祿山所領三鎮兵權，改以顏杲卿等分將，釜底抽薪，安祿山遂下定反策；七月他以奉密詔討楊國忠為名在范陽起兵，蕃漢三鎮之眾齊發，兵鋒直指洛陽、指向朝廷。從更深一層看，開元、天寶年間的均田與租庸調已漸弛壞，府庫空虛，兵源倚賴募兵，中央對地方的號召力削弱；安祿山用契丹降人與胡將作骨幹、另以蕃漢混編與募兵補足人數，正是看中唐廷在北方已無可調之兵。兩座京城之中，長安富而空防，洛陽據天下要衝又握著北方漕運，安軍因此把第一個目標放在東都。
causeEn: The outbreak of the An Lushan revolt grew out of the entanglement between the frontier command system created since Kaiyuan and the growing power of the chancellors, and by the end of the Tianbao years it had tightened into a single rebellion. An Lushan held the military governorships of Fanyang, Pinglu and Hedong all at once; the Zizhi Tongjian records that he commanded two hundred thousand men, and he was not trusted by the court. Chancellor Yang Guozhong mistrusted him in return and repeatedly urged his destruction, while Khitan and Xi raids in Hebei forced the frontier troops to tie down most of their best men in garrison duty. The troops of the three districts were in fact the private following of their governors and could not be transferred by the court, and that is the capital on which the rebel army was raised. In the fourteenth year of Tianbao (755) the emperor ordered that the command of the three districts be divided and given to men such as Yan Gaoqing; this struck at the root, and An Lushan decided on revolt. In the seventh month he rose at Fanyang under the banner of a secret edict against Yang Guozhong, and the mixed Chinese and foreign troops of the three districts moved together, their point driven straight at Luoyang and at the court. At a deeper level, the equal-field system and the tax system of rent, labour and cloth had decayed through the Kaiyuan and Tianbao years, the treasuries were empty, soldiers had to be hired, and the authority of the centre over the localities had thinned. An Lushan built his core on Khitan defectors and non-Han generals, filling out his numbers with mixed units and recruits, precisely because the Tang had no mobile force left in the north. Of the two capitals, Chang'an was rich but open, while Luoyang held the strategic pivot of the empire and the northern grain traffic; the rebel army therefore set its first target at the eastern capital.
impact: 東都陷落是唐王朝由盛轉衰的分水嶺。洛陽一失，北方屏障與漕運樞紐同時落入叛軍之手，江淮漕米改由陸路入關，供養效率驟降；玄宗西幸成都，太子李亨嗣位靈武，中央政權在名號上仍然存在，實際上卻只能靠幾支勤王軍與河北義軍在黃河兩岸撐住。戰局由速決變成持久：常山、平原兩地響應之後，河北十七郡先後樹旗，安軍腹背受敵，始終無法把河北與江南連成一片，攻勢在潼關前被硬生生截住。制度上，安史之亂暴露了節度使坐大、邊軍失控的老問題，亂平之後河朔三鎮自署官吏、不朝天子，藩鎮割據成為定制，中樞財政由租庸調改行兩稅；經濟與社會上，兩京殘破、士族衣冠大舉南遷，中原人口銳減，洛陽的繁華一去不返，杜甫三吏三別所寫的正是亂後兵禍與徵發的實況。武器史上，配石砲這類拋石器在中古攻城戰中的地位也由此役定型：它讓守方再不能倚賴城頭居高，攻城方的技術優勢第一次壓過城防的傳統優勢。
impactEn: The fall of the eastern capital is the watershed between the height of the Tang and its decline. With Luoyang lost, the northern screen and the hinge of the grain traffic passed at one stroke into the hands of the rebels; rice from the south had to come by road through the passes, and the supply of the capital grew far less efficient. The emperor fled west to Chengdu and the crown prince took the throne at Lingwu, so that the central government survived in name, while in reality it could hold on only through a few relief armies and the volunteers of Hebei on both banks of the Yellow River. The war changed from a quick decision into a long one: after Changshan and Pingyuan answered the call and the seventeen prefectures of Hebei raised their banners in turn, the rebels were harried in the rear and could never join Hebei to the south; their advance was stopped dead in front of Tong Pass. Institutionally the rebellion exposed the old evils of over-mighty provincial commands and uncontrolled frontier troops, and after it was over the three circuits of Heshuo appointed their own officials and did not pay court, so that the independent commands of the provinces became a standing arrangement and the central finances passed from the rent, labour and cloth system to the two-tax system. Economically and socially the two capitals were ruined, the clans of the north migrated south in great numbers, the population of the plains fell, and the splendour of Luoyang was never recovered; what Du Fu wrote in his poems of the conscripts and the partings of the war years is the reality behind that ruin. In the history of weapons, the place of throwing engines such as the peishi pao in the siege warfare of the middle ages was settled by this campaign: the defender could no longer rely on the height of the wall, and for the first time the technical advantage of the besieger outweighed the traditional advantages of fortification.
result: 結果是安軍在755年12月（天寶十四載十一月）攻入洛陽，唐朝的東都易主。安祿山在洛陽即皇帝位，國號大燕，年號聖武，以洛陽為中心發號施令，徵發丁壯、括取府庫、接管北方漕運，聲勢壓過唐廷。安軍自起兵至此僅用約半年，遂有不戰而克兩京的說法，實則陳留、鄭州、洛陽一線仍是實打實的攻城，鄭州與洛陽更見砲火、雲梯與巷戰的痕跡。安軍的勝利止於潼關：756年六月，哥舒翰出關迎戰，在靈寶大敗，長安淪陷，唐廷退保蜀中與靈武；其後唐軍與河北義軍在睢陽、太原死守，把叛軍拖入消耗戰。757年史思明再陷洛陽，763年亂事平定時洛陽又易主一次。最終安史之亂以叛軍失敗告終，前後八年，唐雖復兩京，卻已不是開元舊日的唐：藩鎮、兵亂與兩稅並行，國力大衰，盛世的餘暉在東都的廢墟上正式收尾。
resultEn: The outcome was that the rebel army entered Luoyang in the eleventh month of the fourteenth year of Tianbao, that is December 755, and the eastern capital of the Tang changed hands. An Lushan assumed the imperial title at Luoyang, proclaimed the state of Great Yan with the era name Shengwu, and from that city issued his orders, pressing men into the ranks, taking over the treasuries and seizing the northern grain traffic, so that the rebel cause overawed the Tang. It took An's army only about half a year from the rising to this, and there is a saying that the two capitals fell without a battle; in truth Chenliu, Zhengzhou and Luoyang were taken by real siege, and at Zhengzhou and Luoyang the traces of stone-throwing, scaling ladders and street fighting are plain. The rebel advance was halted at Tong Pass: in the sixth month of 756 Geshu Han left the pass to give battle, was beaten at Lingbao, Chang'an was lost, and the court fell back on Shu and Lingwu. Thereafter the Tang troops and the volunteers of Hebei held out at Suiyang and Taiyuan and dragged the rebels into a war of attrition. Shi Siming took Luoyang again in 757, and when the rebellion was finally settled in 763 the city changed hands once more. In the end the An Lushan revolt ended in the defeat of the rebels after eight years. The Tang recovered the two capitals, but it was no longer the Tang of Kaiyuan: provincial commands, mutiny and the two-tax system ran side by side, the state was greatly weakened, and the last glow of the great age closed over the ruins of the eastern capital.
